name: Proxmox VE (fleet)
description: Reads a Proxmox cluster's nodes and the machines on them, so the graph can answer what goes down if one host is rebooted — and can change a machine's power state behind the guarded action.

config.label: Proxmox address
config.hint: Where the API answers, for example https://pve1.dc2.example.com:8006. Any node of the cluster will do; they all answer for the whole of it.

config.label: API token id
config.hint: The whole identifier, for example infracms@pve!fleet. The secret half is written separately, on the Adapters screen, and is never stored here.

config.label: Include containers
config.hint: Read LXC containers as well as virtual machines. Turn this off only if containers are somebody else's to look after.

config.label: Verify the certificate
config.hint: Turn this off only for a cluster using its own self-signed certificate on a management network you control.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: A busy node answers slowly, and an inventory read must not become an operator staring at a spinner.
